eternity.linePrev: Now, Cupid, if your arrow make her love strong for me
eternity.line: I promise I will love her until eternity
eternity.lineNext: I know between the two of us, her heart we can steal
stanza: Now, Cupid, if your arrow make her love strong for me
I promise I will love her until eternity
I know between the two of us, her heart we can steal
Help me if you will
So

eternity.linePrev: Many things raced through my mind
eternity.line: And in the lonely chanting of the sea, I heard the echoes of eternity
eternity.lineNext: And in the fantasy of cloud and sky, I saw The One Who Lives
stanza: I had a little boat
I called it Life
I went out and never came back
All of a sudden, there was a big wind
And waves like mountains
Many things raced through my mind
And in the lonely chanting of the sea, I heard the echoes of eternity
And in the fantasy of cloud and sky, I saw The One Who Lives
While all things die
And I was swallowed by the sea
And lost in the deep
And washed up on the shore

eternity.line: To protect you for all eternity
eternity.lineNext: And with this wood I beat this drum
stanza: The blood of God is my defence
Let it drip down to my seed
Showers to your innocence
To protect you for all eternity
And with this wood I beat this drum
And we won't see defeat
From kings and queens becomes a prince
Knowledge and wisdom is understanding what we need

eternity.linePrev: Well, I looked at the granite markers
eternity.line: Those tributes to finality, to eternity
eternity.lineNext: And then I looked at myself here
stanza: Well, I looked at the granite markers
Those tributes to finality, to eternity
And then I looked at myself here
Chicken scratching for my immortality

eternity.linePrev: Through the glass, I'd watch you breathe
stanza: Through the glass, I'd watch you breathe
Not even eternity
Bound and drowned
And paler than you've ever been
Will hold Houdini
With your life the only thing in my mind —
We pull you from the water
Houdini...
Him and I in the room
To prove you are with us too
He's using code that only you and I know
This is no trick of his
This is your magic
I'd catch the queues, watching you
Hoping you'd do something wrong
Everybody thinks you'll never make it —
But every time you escape,
Rosabel believe, not even Eternity —
Can hold Houdini
"Rosabel, believe!"

eternity.linePrev: We'll lay in bags as dead as leaves
eternity.lineNext: But don't you weep (Don't you weep for us)
stanza: But I can't help it now
Looking for faces in the clouds
I've got some friends I barely see
But we're all planning to meet
We'll lay in bags as dead as leaves
All together for eternity

eternity.songTitle: The Man with the Child in His Eyes
stanza: And suddenly I find myself
Listening to a man I've never known before
Telling me about the sea
All his love, till eternity

eternity.linePrev: Her name's on my tongue and her blood's in my stream
eternity.lineNext: Old mother nature's got nothing on me
stanza: Wait awhile, eternity
Old mother nature's got nothing on me
Come to me, run to me, come to me now
We're rolling, my sweetheart, we're flowing, by God

eternity.line: For she fears that one will ask her for eternity
eternity.lineNext: And she's so busy being free
stanza: She has brought them to her senses
They have laughed inside her laughter
Now she rallies her defenses
For she fears that one will ask her for eternity
And she's so busy being free

eternity.linePrev: Maybe the question was too much to ask
eternity.line: You and I could see into the same eternity
eternity.lineNext: Every second brimming with a majesty
stanza: You and I could see into the same eternity
Every second brimming with a majesty

eternity.lineNext: Out you go, in you be
stanza: Goodness her, goodness me
Goodness eternity
Out you go, in you be
Dried roses
